Dedicated drum thickness sander · master build plans
• Work the ST sheets in order. Each one is a single session
• A step sheet tells you what to fetch, what to do, and what
must be true before you move on.
• When a step names a part, open that part's P-sheet for the
• Grey geometry on a step illustration is already built.
Colored geometry is what you add.
• Do not skip a QC gate. They are placed where a mistake is
RELEASE CONDITIONS — ALL MUST BE MET
☐ Transfer the purchased 4-bolt flange to the panel before
drilling. The bolt square on the drawings is ASSUMED.
☐ Measure ply_actual and regenerate. Keep the 16.5″ inner
span; do not shrink it to suit 18 mm stock.
☐ Motor circuit, switch, grounding, and cord: qualified
electrician and local code. Not released by this package.
☐ Commission with the hood on and no stock, standing clear
☐ Confirm TIR, |A−B|, and witness-board scatter before the
machine is used on real work.
